name: learning-planner
description: A learning companion skill that helps plan, track, and review self-directed learning journeys in structured phases. Supports natural language interaction (English & Chinese) and generates Obsidian-compatible markdown files with checkbox task tracking, progress summaries, and phase archives. Triggers on phrases like "plan my study", "学习计划", "what should I learn next", "阶段结束", "review my progress".
